note: the glow and shadow mask is read at y plus dy instead of y minus dy, so a drop shadow with positive dy moves up, caught by AlphaEffectLightTests.shadowMovesDown
the inner glow and shadow are not clipped by the layer alpha, so an inner shadow paints the transparent pixels around the shape, caught by AlphaEffectLightTests.innerStaysInside
the glow ignores its intensity, so every nonzero intensity glows as 1, caught by AlphaEffectLightTests.intensityScalesGlow
the glow and shadow blur by reach over six instead of reach over three, so a glow reaches half its radius, caught by AlphaEffectLightTests.glowReachesItsRadius
the light mask is padded one pixel whatever the offset, so an offset cannot pull in blur that spilled past the edge, caught by AlphaEffectLightTests.offsetPullsInBlurPastTheEdge
the inner glow and shadow darken the layer by the mask cover instead of the light's alpha, so a clear inner shadow changes the layer, caught by AlphaEffectLightTests.intensityZeroIsIdentity
